policy: Licensing is dataset-specific. There is no blanket licence for biblical data. An entry whose verification_status is not 'verified' confers NO rights and may NOT be ingested. A 'verified' status additionally requires an open milestone gate and per-dataset human authorisation before ingestion. Aggregator-level licences never establish rights for an individual item. See .clinerules/050-data-licensing.md and ADR-0010.
ingestion_gate_note: CLOSED at M0. Opening requires a completed architecture review by a human reviewer, recorded with identity and date. See docs/milestones/M0-acceptance-criteria.md.

verification_status_vocabulary.verified: Licence confirmed against a primary source, with URL and retrieval date recorded.
verification_status_vocabulary.unverified: Candidate source under evaluation. Rights NOT established. Not ingestible.
verification_status_vocabulary.disputed: Sources conflict or the terms are contested. Not ingestible.
verification_status_vocabulary.restricted: Licence confirmed but prohibits the intended use. Not ingestible.
verification_status_vocabulary.absent: No licence information located. Not ingestible.

sources.notes: Licence page retrieved 2026-11-05 and found to contain the full text of the Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International Public License. The page footer reads 'Copyright Faithlife / Logos Bible Software'. Download availability was NOT verified from this page and is recorded as unknown. CC BY 4.0 requires attribution; the exact attribution wording the rights holder expects was not stated on the page and must be confirmed before redistribution.
verification_required: Confirm the download location and access conditions.
Confirm the exact attribution wording expected by the rights holder.
Confirm whether copyright is held jointly with the Society of Biblical Literature.

sources.name: Berean Standard Bible (BSB)
sources.rights_holder: Bible Hub / Berean Bible Translation Committee (dedicated to the public domain)
sources.evidence_quote: The Berean Bible and Majority Bible texts are officially dedicated to the public domain as of April 30, 2023. All uses are freely permitted. Attribution Notice (appreciated but not required).
sources.attribution_text: The Holy Bible, Berean Standard Bible, BSB is produced in cooperation with Bible Hub, Discovery Bible, OpenBible.com, and the Berean Bible Translation Committee. This text of God's Word has been dedicated to the public domain.
sources.notes: Terms page retrieved 2026-11-05. IMPORTANT CORRECTION TO A COMMON ASSUMPTION: the Berean texts were previously distributed under a Creative Commons licence and are frequently still described that way. As of 2023-04-30 they are dedicated to the public domain and all uses are freely permitted; attribution is appreciated but not required. The page states that derivatives varying from the official text are respectfully requested not to use the Berean name. That naming request is a request, not a licence condition, but Scriptura will honour it.
verification_required: Confirm the exact release/version identifier of the text actually retrieved at ingestion time, since the dedication covers the texts as published.

sources.name: ETCBC BHSA (Biblia Hebraica Stuttgartensia Amstelodamensis, Text-Fabric)
sources.rights_holder: Eep Talstra Centre for Bible and Computer, VU University Amsterdam
sources.evidence_quote: This work is licensed under a Attribution-NonCommercial 4.0 International (CC BY-NC 4.0) ... do not use the data for commercial applications without consent; for any commercial use, please contact the German Bible Society.
sources.notes: README retrieved 2026-11-05. NON-COMMERCIAL: the data and Scriptura derivatives of it must be quarantined from any commercial distribution channel. The README states that commercial use requires contacting the German Bible Society, which indicates that underlying rights in the BHS text are held separately from the ETCBC annotation; this is a layered-rights situation even though the annotation licence is stated as single. Attribution is by persistent DOI. The extended family (dss, extrabiblical, peshitta, syrnt) was not individually licence-checked and must be verified separately.
verification_required: Verify the licence of each extended-family dataset separately (dss, extrabiblical, peshitta, syrnt). The bhsa licence does not establish rights for them.
Confirm with the German Bible Society what commercial consent would require, if commercial use is ever contemplated.

sources.name: MorphGNT: SBLGNT Edition
sources.rights_holder: MorphGNT project (editor J. K. Tauber); underlying text per the SBLGNT licence
sources.licence: Layered: annotation CC-BY-SA (version not stated); underlying SBLGNT text per SBLGNT terms
sources.evidence_quote: The SBLGNT text itself is subject to the SBLGNT EULA and the morphological parsing and lemmatization is made available under a CC-BY-SA License.
sources.attribution_text: Tauber, J. K., ed. (2017) MorphGNT: SBLGNT Edition. Version 6.12 [Data set]. https://github.com/morphgnt/sblgnt DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.376200
sources.citation: Tauber, J. K., ed. (2017) MorphGNT: SBLGNT Edition. Version 6.12 [Data set]. https://github.com/morphgnt/sblgnt DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.376200
sources.notes: README retrieved 2026-11-05. This is the canonical example of LAYERED licensing: the annotation and the underlying text carry different licences, and both must be resolved. The README states 'CC-BY-SA' WITHOUT a version number, and refers to the 'SBLGNT EULA' rather than naming CC BY 4.0; the SBLGNT licence page itself was verified to contain the CC BY 4.0 text (see src-sblgnt), but the discrepancy in how the two sources describe the same licence must be resolved before ingestion. Marked NOT ingestible pending that resolution. Share-alike: any Scriptura derivative of the annotation inherits CC BY-SA.
verification_required: Resolve which CC BY-SA version applies to the annotation (the README does not state one).
Reconcile the README's reference to a 'SBLGNT EULA' with the CC BY 4.0 text published at the SBLGNT licence page.
Confirm commercial-use status once the share-alike version is known.

sources.name: STEPBible-Data
sources.rights_holder: STEP Bible (Charitable Incorporated Organisation, UK #1193950); data created initially by Tyndale House Cambridge
sources.evidence_quote: # STEPBible Data Repository  **CC BY 4.0** ... And you should: * **Credit it** to "STEP Bible" linked to www.STEPBible.org
sources.attribution_text: Credit to "STEP Bible" linked to www.STEPBible.org
sources.notes: README retrieved 2026-11-05. The repository as a whole is stated to be CC BY 4.0, with credit to 'STEP Bible'. CAVEAT REQUIRING SEPARATE VERIFICATION: the repository includes TTESV (Translators Tags for ESV), which are tags applied to the translated text of the ESV. The ESV text itself is a separately copyrighted modern translation whose terms were NOT verified by Scriptura. The CC BY 4.0 statement covers STEPBible's own data; it does not and cannot establish rights in a third party's Bible translation. TTESV and any dataset embedding a modern copyrighted translation must be verified separately and are NOT covered by this entry.
verification_required: Verify the licence of the ESV text separately before ingesting TTESV or anything embedding ESV text.
Verify each individual dataset in the repository (TAHOT, TAGNT, ProperNames, and others) where its content derives from a third-party source rather than from Tyndale House work.

sources.name: Sefaria-Export
sources.rights_holder: Per text. There is no single rights holder for the collection.
sources.evidence_quote: Each text is licensed separately, so there is no overall license for this repository. You can find the license for each text in their JSON versions under the `license` field. This is generally either "Public Domain", "CC0", "CC-BY", "CC-BY-SA" or "CC-BY-NC".
sources.notes: LICENSE.md retrieved 2026-11-05. This source is the canonical demonstration of why licensing must be dataset-specific and often ITEM-specific: the rights holder states explicitly that there is NO overall licence for the collection. The per-item licensing MODEL is verified from a primary source; no individual text is verified. Each text's `license` field must be read individually before that text may be ingested. Note that the stated range includes CC-BY-NC, so some items would require non-commercial quarantine. NOT ingestible as a collection under any circumstances.
verification_required: Read the `license` field of each individual text intended for ingestion.
Record a separate registry entry and licence record for each item actually used.
Apply non-commercial quarantine to any item licensed CC-BY-NC.

sources.name: eBible.org translation corpus
sources.rights_holder: Per translation. eBible.org records the copyright owner for each translation.
sources.evidence_quote: Listings with a white background are freely redistributable, at possibly with a noncommercial restriction. Listings with a gray background may not be redistributed without permission of the copyright owner.
sources.notes: Bible List page retrieved 2026-11-05. Redistributability is determined PER TRANSLATION and is visually encoded in the listing, with some freely redistributable translations still carrying a non-commercial restriction. The listing page is not a licence for any translation; each translation's own copyright page must be read. Background colour in a web listing is not a durable machine-readable licence record, so per-translation verification is mandatory. NOT ingestible as a collection.
verification_required: Read the copyright page of each individual translation intended for ingestion.
Record whether the translation carries a non-commercial restriction and quarantine if so.

sources.name: Perseus Digital Library (Hopper)
sources.rights_holder: Tufts University holds the overall copyright to the Perseus Digital Library; individual materials have varying copyright status
sources.evidence_quote: Tufts University holds the overall copyright to the Perseus Digital Library; the materials therein ... are provided for the personal use of students, scholars, and the public. Any commercial use or publication without authorization is strictly prohibited. Materials within the Perseus DL have varying copyright status.
sources.citation: Perseus Digital Library. Ed. Gregory R. Crane. Tufts University. http://www.perseus.tufts.edu
sources.notes: Copyright page retrieved 2026-11-05. IMPORTANT FINDING, CONTRARY TO A COMMON ASSUMPTION: the Perseus Hopper is NOT a blanket open-licence collection. Tufts holds the overall copyright, materials are provided for personal use, commercial use or publication without authorisation is strictly prohibited, and materials have varying copyright status. Some texts are used by agreement with publishers who hold their copyrights. The page states that links are always preferable to copying, and that some materials are governed by special copyrights prohibiting reproduction outside the Perseus environment. Recorded as 'restricted': not ingestible. NOTE: this concerns the Hopper site. The Open Greek and Latin GitHub data is a separate matter and is recorded separately at src-ogl-first1kgreek.
verification_required: Contact the Perseus project about any specific component before use, as the copyright page itself directs.
Do not treat the Hopper as a source of freely redistributable text.

sources.rights_holder: Open Greek and Latin / Perseus Digital Library (per secondary attribution)
sources.evidence_quote: # First1KGreek — XML files for the works in the First Thousand Years of Greek Project. (The README states NO licence. A request for /LICENSE at the repository root returned HTTP 404.)
sources.notes: README retrieved 2026-11-05: it states no licence, and no LICENSE file was found at the repository root (HTTP 404). A third-party catalogue attributes specific texts from this repository to 'CC BY-SA 4.0: Perseus Digital Library / Open Greek and Latin (First1KGreek)', but that is SECONDARY evidence and does not establish rights. Absence of a licence statement is NOT a public-domain statement; under copyright law the default is all rights reserved. Recorded as unverified and NOT ingestible. This is a case where the honest answer is that the licence is unknown, not that the material is free.

Check for a licence file in subdirectories or in the project wiki.

sources.name: Beta masaheft (Ethiopic manuscript and text corpus, Universitat Hamburg)
sources.rights_holder: Beta masaheft project, Universitat Hamburg (per secondary attribution)
sources.notes: NOT consulted directly at M0. A third-party catalogue attributes specific Geez texts (1 Enoch, Jubilees, from the Ethiopian Orthodox Tewahedo Church printed Bible) to 'CC BY-SA 4.0 (Beta masaheft, Universitat Hamburg)' and notes that a SEPARATE scholarly edition in the same file is non-commercial only. That is SECONDARY evidence, and the note about mixed licensing within a single file is precisely the layered-licensing hazard this registry exists to surface. Recorded as unverified; the repository itself must be consulted before any use.
verification_required: Consult the repository's own licence statement.
Determine the licence of each individual work file, since a single file may contain material under different licences.

sources.name: Westminster Leningrad Codex (WLC)
sources.notes: NOT consulted directly at M0. The Open Scriptures Hebrew Bible LICENSE.md asserts that the Westminster Leningrad Codex 'is in the public domain'. That is a SECONDARY assertion made by a downstream project, not a statement by the WLC's own publisher. The underlying Hebrew text of the Leningrad Codex is medieval and its text is not in copyright, but the digital ENCODING of a critical edition may carry its own rights, which is exactly the distinction .clinerules/050-data-licensing.md section 6 requires Scriptura to resolve. Recorded as unverified.
verification_required: Establish who published the digital WLC encoding and on what terms.
Distinguish the rights in the medieval text from any rights in the digital encoding.
